cloy.definition: v. cause surfeit through excess though initially pleasing
cloy.translation:
vt. 使吃饱, 使过饱, 使厌腻
vi. 倒胃口

cloyed.translation: v. <正>发腻, 倒胃口( cloy的过去式和过去分词 )

cloying.translation: a. 厌烦的；倒胃口的；因过量而厌烦的

cloyingly.definition: r. in an overly sweet manner

cloyless.translation: a. 不会倒胃口的, 不会使人感到腻烦的

cloyne.translation: [人名] 克洛因; [地名] [爱尔兰、加拿大] 克洛因

cloys.definition:
v supply or feed to surfeit
v cause surfeit through excess though initially pleasing
cloys.translation: v. <正>发腻, 倒胃口( cloy的第三人称单数 )
